The bug was that `Console.print` and `Console.log` defaulted to printing a `NewLine()` when no objects were provided, which ignored the `end` parameter. By changing the default to an empty string `("",)`, the `end` parameter is correctly processed by `_collect_renderables` and `Text.render`, allowing `console.print(end="")` to print nothing and `console.print(end="foo")` to print "foo".

Summary of changes:
- Modified `rich/console.py` to change `objects = (NewLine(),)` to `objects = ("",)` in both `Console.print` and `Console.log` methods.
